translations.text: Father of mankind, I ask you for comfort, holy Lord, you who are in heaven.
May your name now be hallowed, made firm by the powers of the mind, saving Christ, and firmly set within the enclosure of our hearts.
May your kingdom come now to men, to us, wielder of powers, righteous judge, and may faith in you remain glorious in our minds through the days of our life.
And may your will be done among us in our dwelling in the kingdom of earth, as clear as it is in the glory of heaven, made beautiful with joys, for ever and ever.
Give us now today, Lord of men, high King of the heavens, our bread, which you sent into the middle-earth of mankind for the salvation of souls; that is the pure Christ, the Lord God.
Forgive us, guardian of men, our guilts and sins, and release us from our vices, the wounds of the body, and our wicked deeds, since we often anger you, the merciful, almighty God,
just as we forgive on earth the vices of those who often sin against us, and do not intend to punish them for their wrongdoing, so that we may earn eternal life.
Do not lead us into punishment, into the sorrow of misery, nor into temptation, saving Christ, lest we, without grace, become estranged from all your mercies through enmity.
And deliver us also now from evil, from every one of the fiends;
in the enclosure of our hearts, Prince of angels, true Lord of victory, we eagerly offer thanks and glory, because you graciously, by your powers, set us free from captivity in the torment of hell.
